privacidad.page_description: Forj's Privacy Policy. Learn how we handle your personal data.
privacidad.title: Privacy Policy

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: Forj (hereinafter "the company"), with registered address in Spain, is the data controller for the personal data provided by users through this website.

sections.title: 2. Data Collected
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly by filling out the contact form: name, email address and phone number. We also collect browsing data through technical and analytical cookies.

sections.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
sections.body: Your data will be used to: (a) respond to your request for information or quote, (b) send you commercial communications if you have given your consent, and (c) improve our services through browsing analysis.

sections.title: 4. Legal Basis
sections.body: Processing is based on your explicit consent when submitting the form and, where applicable, on the company's legitimate interest in improving its services.

sections.title: 5. Retention
sections.body: We will retain your data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was collected, and for the legally established periods.

sections.title: 6. Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectify, delete, restrict processing, object to processing and request data portability. You can exercise these rights by writing to hello@forj.es.

cookies.page_description: Forj's Cookie Policy. Learn how we use cookies.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy

sections.title: 1. What are cookies?
sections.body: Cookies are small text files that are stored in your browser when you visit a website. They allow us to remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.

sections.title: 2. Types of cookies we use
items: Technical cookies: necessary for the website to function. They do not require consent.
Analytical cookies: help us understand how users interact with the site, so we can improve it.
Preference cookies: remember your settings (such as dark mode) to provide you with a personalized experience.

sections.title: 3. Managing cookies
sections.body: You can manage cookies from your browser settings. Please note that blocking technical cookies may affect website functionality.

sections.title: 4. Third-party cookies
sections.body: This website does not use third-party cookies for advertising or external tracking.

sections.title: 5. More information
sections.body: If you have any questions about our cookie policy, write to us at hello@forj.es.
